{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Read the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Check the premises
print("Checking premises:")
print(f"- 'converted' == 1 implies completed checkout: {df['converted'].isin([0,1]).all()}")
print(f"- Customer age is in years: {df['customer_age'].dtype == 'int64'}")
print(f"- Mean is over converted customers: {df['converted'].sum()} converted orders found")

# Inspect the data
print(f"\nShape: {df.shape}")
print(f"Unique channels: {df['channel'].unique()}")
print(f"Unique segments: {df['customer_segment'].unique()}")
print(f"Unique statuses: {df['status'].unique()}")
print(f"Min, max age: {df['customer_age'].min()}, {df['customer_age'].max()}")
print(f"Age -1 count: {(df['customer_age'] == -1).sum()} out of {len(df)} ({(df['customer_age'] == -1).sum()/len(df)*100:.1f}%)")
print(f"Revenue dtype: {df['revenue'].dtype}")

# Check for sentinel values in revenue
print(f"Revenue '999999.99' count: {(df['revenue'] == '999999.99').sum()} rows")

# Check for refunded orders
print(f"Refunded orders count: {(df['status'] == 'refunded').sum()} rows")

# Check that 'converted' is binary
print(f"'converted' unique values: {df['converted'].unique()}")"}
